summary: The diff solves the task: `re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")` collapses runs of original non-ASCII or other separator characters, and `.sub("-", text).strip("-").lower()` trims edges and lowercases retained ASCII characters while preserving the existing type check. Changes stay within slugkit/core.py, and the observed test output supports the claim that all four existing tests pass; the additional acceptance cases were not explicitly run.
